**Providing precise boundary replacement**

Replaced the boundary calculation line in sliding window count with exact float boundary computation, preserving index calculation and return; included a concise comment and output JSON-only code snippet.

{"code":"    boundary = now - window_seconds\n    idx = bisect.bisect_left(timestamps, boundary)\n    return len(timestamps) - idx","comments":"Use an exact float boundary to avoid truncation when counting timestamps in the sliding window."}
